name: Ice Cream Parlor
role: You are a cheerful scoop staff.
speaker: Scoop Staff

tasks.goal: Greet the scoop staff and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the scoop staff and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Inquire about popular artisanal ice cream flavors available today
tasks.hint: Ask staff what signature flavors are fresh.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about popular ice cream flavors.

tasks.goal: Ask for a sample taste of mint chocolate chip ice cream
tasks.hint: Request tasting sample on wooden spoon.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to sample ice cream flavor.

tasks.goal: Request two scoops of salted caramel in a freshly baked waffle cone
tasks.hint: Specify flavor, scoop count, and cone type.
tasks.done_when: Learner ordered ice cream scoops in waffle cone.
tasks.scene_hint: Crisp waffle cone iron sizzles as cheerful music plays over ice cream counter.

tasks.goal: Ask about dairy-free sorbet or vegan oat milk ice cream choices
tasks.hint: Inquire about dietary alternatives.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about vegan or dairy-free ice cream options.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'specialty'
tasks.hint: A specialty is a product or service that a business is known for. Inquire about house dessert specialties on the menu.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'specialty'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about extra toppings like hot fudge, sprinkles, or crushed nuts
tasks.hint: Ask what ice cream toppings are offered.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about available ice cream toppings.

tasks.goal: Negotiate getting extra hot fudge sauce without additional surcharge
tasks.hint: Politely ask if extra topping fee can be waived.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for extra topping without extra charge.

tasks.goal: Ask if hand-packed pints can be packed with dry ice for takeaway
tasks.hint: Inquire about taking ice cream home safely.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about hand-packed pints and dry ice packaging.

tasks.goal: Politely report receiving wrong ice cream scoop and request correction
tasks.hint: Point out flavor mix-up to staff.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported incorrect flavor scoop and requested correction.
tasks.scene_hint: Ice cream scoops dip into deep colorful freezer tubs under glass counter.

tasks.goal: Ask if ice cream cake orders require 24 hours advance notice
tasks.hint: Inquire about custom ice cream cake orders.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ice cream cake advance notice rules.

tasks.goal: Confirm total price for scoops and premium cone upgrade
tasks.hint: Verify payment total with cashier.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed ice cream payment total.

tasks.goal: Request printed itemized receipt showing scoop breakdown
tasks.hint: Ask for transaction receipt.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed ice cream receipt.

tasks.goal: Ask for extra napkins and plastic spoons for takeaway cup
tasks.hint: Request cutlery supplies at counter.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested napkins and spoons.

tasks.goal: Thank the scoop staff and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the scoop staff AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Inquire about seasonal fruit sorbet options available today
tasks.hint: Ask staff about available fresh fruit sorbets.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about seasonal fruit sorbet options.
tasks.scene_hint: Chilled metal tubs display colorful mango and raspberry sorbet under bright glass counter tops.

tasks.goal: Ask for assistance choosing between milkshakes and ice cream floats
tasks.hint: Ask staff for recommendations on blended drinks.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested help choosing between milkshakes and floats.
tasks.scene_hint: A chrome milkshake blender whirs loudly beside metal cups of root beer float soda.

tasks.goal: Inquire about sugar-free or diabetic-friendly ice cream offerings
tasks.hint: Ask staff if low-sugar ice cream options exist.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about sugar-free ice cream options.
tasks.scene_hint: A chalk board menu highlights sugar-free vanilla bean ice cream next to the glass dipping cabinet.

tasks.goal: Confirm insulated thermal bag packaging for hot summer transport
tasks.hint: Ask staff if thermal takeaway bag is available.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed insulated thermal bag packaging.
tasks.scene_hint: Condensation beads on the ice cream display freezer while silver thermal takeaway bags rest on the counter.

tasks.goal: Ask about gift card denominations available at register
tasks.hint: Inquire what amounts can be loaded onto gift cards.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ice cream gift card options.
tasks.scene_hint: Colorful plastic ice cream gift cards rest in a small display holder beside the cash register.

tasks.goal: Request loyalty stamp card for free scoop after ten visits
tasks.hint: Ask cashier for loyalty reward card.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested ice cream loyalty stamp card.
tasks.scene_hint: A rubber stamp and paper loyalty cards sit next to the glass ice cream spoon dispenser.

tasks.goal: Confirm closing time for late-night ice cream craving
tasks.hint: Ask staff what time parlor closes tonight.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed parlor closing time.
tasks.scene_hint: Neon signs glow blue in the window while a neon clock ticks above the topping bar.

tasks.goal: Ask if digital receipt can be texted to mobile phone
tasks.hint: Request receipt sent electronically to mobile number.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for digital receipt via text.
tasks.scene_hint: The register printer hums softly as paper rolls sit beside a smartphone tap-payment reader.

tasks.goal: Confirm outdoor patio seating availability behind parlor
tasks.hint: Ask staff where patio seating is located.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed outdoor patio seating availability.
tasks.scene_hint: Wrought-iron patio tables and umbrellas are visible through the back glass door.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'gelato'
tasks.hint: Gelato is dense Italian-style ice cream made with less air and fat. Inquire about available gelato flavors.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'gelato'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'refreshment'
tasks.hint: A refreshment is a light food or drink serving. Ask for cold fruit refreshments on a hot afternoon.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'refreshment'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'expiry'
tasks.hint: Expiry refers to the date after which a product is no longer fresh or safe to consume. Inquire about the expiry date of pre-packaged ice cream tubs.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'expiry'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'churned'
tasks.hint: Churned describes ice cream mixed during freezing to build texture. Ask if the ice cream is freshly churned.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'churned'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about nut allergy cross-contamination safety protocols
tasks.hint: Ask if separate scoop scoops non-nut flavors.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about nut allergy safety protocols.
tasks.scene_hint: Clean metal scoops soak in a running water well next to allergen warning labels.

tasks.goal: Ask if waffle cones are baked fresh in store daily
tasks.hint: Inquire about house-made waffle cone baking schedule.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if waffle cones are baked fresh daily.
tasks.scene_hint: The sweet aroma of baking batter fills the air as a waffle cone iron sizzles.

tasks.goal: Request double chocolate scoop in dipped chocolate waffle bowl
tasks.hint: Specify chocolate scoop and dipped bowl selection.
tasks.done_when: Learner ordered double chocolate scoop in dipped bowl.

tasks.goal: Inquire about ice cream sandwich cookie flavor combinations
tasks.hint: Ask which fresh-baked cookies are used for sandwiches.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ice cream sandwich cookie options.

tasks.goal: Address issue where ice cream scoop is melting too quickly in heat
tasks.hint: Ask staff for cup under cone to catch drips.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested extra cup for melting ice cream cone.

tasks.goal: Ask about signature sundae combinations with whipped cream and cherry
tasks.hint: Inquire about parlor specialty sundae menu.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about signature sundae options.

tasks.goal: Request sample of spicy chili chocolate flavor on spoon
tasks.hint: Ask staff for taste test of unique spicy chocolate flavor.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested sample of chili chocolate ice cream.

tasks.goal: Inquire if parlor caters ice cream carts for birthday parties
tasks.hint: Ask about event catering services and mobile carts.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ice cream catering for events.

tasks.goal: Ask about gluten-free cone availability for celiac diet
tasks.hint: Inquire if gluten-free waffle cones are stocked.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about gluten-free cone options.

tasks.goal: Request extra crushed waffle cone bits sprinkled on top
tasks.hint: Ask staff for waffle cone crunch topping.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested crushed waffle cone bits on top.

tasks.goal: Inquire about hot espresso poured over cold vanilla gelato
tasks.hint: Ask if espresso for affogato is freshly brewed.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about espresso poured over gelato.

tasks.goal: Report receiving single scoop instead of double scoop ordered
tasks.hint: Point out scoop count discrepancy to staff.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported receiving single scoop instead of double.

tasks.goal: Ask about banana split traditional presentation ingredients
tasks.hint: Inquire what sauces and toppings come on banana split.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about banana split presentation details.

tasks.goal: Request staff add extra maraschino cherries to ice cream cup
tasks.hint: Ask for extra cherry garnish on dessert.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested extra maraschino cherries.

tasks.goal: Inquire about house-made marshmallow fluff topping
tasks.hint: Ask if marshmallow topping is toasted or plain.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about house-made marshmallow fluff topping.

tasks.goal: Ask if parlor sells ice cream flights with four miniature scoops
tasks.hint: Inquire about tasting flight options on wooden tray.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ice cream tasting flights.

tasks.goal: Report finding ice crystal chunk inside strawberry ice cream scoop
tasks.hint: Inform staff of freezer burn ice crystals in scoop.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported ice crystals in strawberry ice cream.

tasks.goal: Inquire about Madagascar vanilla bean versus French vanilla
tasks.hint: Ask staff to explain difference between vanilla options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about vanilla bean versus French vanilla differences.

tasks.goal: Ask if takeaway lids fit securely on waffle bowl containers
tasks.hint: Verify lid fit for carrying ice cream home.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about takeaway lid security.

tasks.goal: Request staff layer hot fudge between scoops instead of top only
tasks.hint: Ask for hot fudge drizzled in middle of cup.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested hot fudge layered between scoops.

tasks.goal: Inquire about custom ice cream cake message lettering options
tasks.hint: Ask if piping gel message can be written on cake.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about custom ice cream cake lettering.

tasks.goal: Ask about butter pecan roast level and whole pecan pieces
tasks.hint: Inquire if pecans are salted and roasted in house.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about butter pecan ingredient details.

tasks.goal: Report missing topping on ordered sundae
tasks.hint: Inform staff that requested sprinkles were omitted.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported missing topping on sundae.

tasks.goal: Inquire about dairy-free coconut milk ice cream base texture
tasks.hint: Ask if coconut flavor dominates dairy-free base.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about coconut milk ice cream texture.

tasks.goal: Ask if parlor offers dog-friendly peanut butter pup cups
tasks.hint: Inquire about safe ice cream treats for pets.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about dog-friendly pup cups.

tasks.goal: Request staff press scoops firmly into cone base to prevent falling
tasks.hint: Ask staff to secure scoops tightly inside cone.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested scoops pressed firmly into cone.

tasks.goal: Inquire about artisanal root beer brand used for floats
tasks.hint: Ask which root beer soda is paired with ice cream.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about root beer brand used for floats.

tasks.goal: Ask if sprinkles can be served in separate side cup
tasks.hint: Request rainbow sprinkles on the side.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for sprinkles served in separate cup.

tasks.goal: Report soft melted consistency of sorbet scoop
tasks.hint: Inform staff that sorbet cabinet temperature seems too warm.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported soft melted consistency of sorbet.

tasks.goal: Inquire about dark chocolate cocoa percentage in fudge sauce
tasks.hint: Ask how bitter or sweet hot fudge sauce is.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about cocoa percentage in fudge sauce.

tasks.goal: Ask if ice cream parlor accepts mobile contactless payments
tasks.hint: Inquire if tap pay works at ice cream counter.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about mobile contactless payment support.

tasks.goal: Request staff swap paper cup for waffle cone after order placed
tasks.hint: Ask to change container choice before payment.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested swapping paper cup for waffle cone.

tasks.goal: Inquire about salted caramel ribbon density in ice cream batch
tasks.hint: Ask if caramel swirl is distributed throughout tub.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about salted caramel ribbon density.

tasks.goal: Ask if parlor sells pre-packed ice cream bars on wooden sticks
tasks.hint: Inquire about hand-dipped novelty bars.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about pre-packed ice cream bars.

tasks.goal: Report wrong topping added to scoop order
tasks.hint: Point out topping error to scoop staff.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported wrong topping added to ice cream order.

tasks.goal: Inquire about seasonal pumpkin spice flavor availability in autumn
tasks.hint: Ask when fall seasonal flavors launch.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about seasonal pumpkin spice availability.

tasks.goal: Request staff wipe sticky ice cream drip off outer cone wrapper
tasks.hint: Ask staff for clean napkin around cone base.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested wiping sticky drip off cone wrapper.

tasks.goal: Inquire about malted milk powder addition to chocolate milkshake
tasks.hint: Ask if traditional malt powder can be blended into shake.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about adding malted milk powder to shake.

tasks.goal: Inquire about artisanal waffle cone dipped in rainbow sprinkles
tasks.hint: Ask staff for specialty sprinkle cone.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about sprinkle dipped waffle cone.

tasks.goal: Ask if ice cream parlor serves warm belgian waffle sundaes
tasks.hint: Inquire about warm waffle dessert options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about belgian waffle sundaes.

tasks.goal: Request extra plastic spoon for sharing ice cream cup
tasks.hint: Ask staff for additional spoon.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested extra plastic spoon.

place_translations.Japanese: 風味豊かなアイスクリーム店
